verseText: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes upon you, and you will be My witnesses in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth.”
meaning: Jesus promised that the Holy Spirit would give us power to share the good news, beginning nearby and spreading through the whole world.

recall.question: Jesus promised that someone would come and give us power. Who was he talking about?

meaning.question: A witness is someone who tells others what they know. What does the Holy Spirit give us the power to share?

application.prompt: Sometimes telling others about Jesus can feel scary. But we don't have to do it alone! How could remembering that the Holy Spirit helps us give you courage to share the good news?
